name: Webinar Desk
tagline: It finds webinars in your lanes, attends, and sends back a brief
description: You pick the subject areas worth following and it takes over from there: it finds upcoming sessions, asks before signing you up, then sits in and takes notes so you never watch live. Afterwards a structured five-part summary lands in your inbox, sent from its own mailbox.
author: Ispider
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
